headline: [Market Forecast] KOSPI Knocking Again at 'Seven Thousand Pie'; August Chip Exports and US Employment in Focus
summary: KOSPI is expected to try to settle firmly above 7,000 again next week. August exports, due on the 1st, and US employment data, due on the 4th, are cited as key variables.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers whose export volumes feed into national trade data.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Upcoming chip export and US employment data are cited as factors that will set the index's direction.
